slides.texte_overlay:
small habits that make you
feel rich without money

fresh flowers

buy one small bunch of cheap flowers each week. a little colour on the table makes an ordinary room feel cared for, and it costs less than a fancy coffee.

slow breakfasts

sit down for breakfast with a real cup and a plate instead of eating standing up. taking your time in the morning is a quiet luxury anyone can afford.

a rich mind

knowing a little about art, history and the stars makes you feel rich in a way money can't buy. 5 minutes of learning a day fills your mind with beautiful things to think about.
slides.texte_sophia:
a rich mind

feeling rich started with my mind. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, art, history, the stars, and i feel richer than any shopping trip ever made me.

slides.texte_overlay:
free museums

visit free museums and galleries on quiet weekday afternoons. walking slowly past beautiful things is one of the most luxurious feelings in the world.

looking after what you own

polish your shoes, iron your shirt and fold your clothes properly. caring for the things you already have makes them feel expensive, special and truly yours.
